text: PMX: Informal procedure for parents P1 and P2: - - P1 1. Choose random segment in child and copy it from P1, . 2. Starting from the first crossover point look for elements - - Child in that segment of P2 that have not been copied, 3. For each of these i, look in the offspring to see what — P2 element j has been copied in its place from P1, 4. Place i into the position occupied j in P2, since we know that we will not be putting j there (as is already in offspring). 5. If the place occupied by j in P2 has already been filled in the offspring k, put i in the position occupied by k in P2, 6. Having dealt with the elements from the crossover segment, the rest of the offspring can be filled from P2. Second child is created analogously.
